issues.description: The problem specification and UML refer to animal classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat, but the solution implementation provides classes named SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat (while leaving Goat.java, Pig.java, and Seal.java empty). This identifier mismatch means the concrete class names students are asked to implement do not match the provided solution artifacts, which is likely to confuse students about the expected class names and will break any direct comparisons or example usages that assume Seal/Pig/Goat exist.
issues.suggestedFix: Align identifiers between specification and implementation. Either rename the solution classes SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat to Seal, Pig, and Goat (and update their filenames accordingly), or provide concrete implementations in Goat.java, Pig.java, and Seal.java that delegate to or extend the Space* classes. Alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to refer to the Space-prefixed class names consistently. The recommended fix is to rename the Space* classes to the expected names so students and tests refer to the same identifiers.
